AGO.note: The document states nothing on rules or an authority on AI harms.

facts.fact: Targeting, citing Jornal de Angola, reports that IGAPE has developed the AI and RPA platform SEP360, in its final phase, to automate collection, analysis and monitoring of state-enterprise data, with launch expected by the end of January 2026.

AGO.note: SEP360 supervises state enterprises, which is general administration rather than a named sector system.
The document states a government platform with AI, not an AI model, dataset or computing facility.
